summary: The website aims to provide assistance for a potential human colony in planet Mars. It not only gives the user the necessary details for survival, it also maps a much needed map to help these humans in another affairs such as recreational activities, the ideal places to settle in and the dangerous places affected by Mars' harsh climate.
details: Our project displays a 3D and 2D map of Mars. It works as stated in the following: We have downloaded official Mars maps and models directly from NASA sources. With the help of Artificial intelligence, we have designed a Javascript code that can project different map modes of Mars with the click of a button. We have used Google Antigravity to assist us. Our team came up with the idea and did the research. The intended impact of this project is to provide a free source resource for future Mars settlement.
